def count_regular_bracket_sequences(n, s):
    m = len(s)
    
    # dp[i][j] will store the number of ways to form a regular bracket sequence of length i with j unmatched '('
    dp = [[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(2 * n + 1)]
    
    # Base case: empty sequence has one way to be regular
    dp[0][0] = 1
    
    for i in range(1, 2 * n + 1):
        for j in range(i + 1):
            if j > 0:
                dp[i][j] += dp[i - 1][j - 1]
                dp[i][j] %= MOD
            if j < i:
                dp[i][j] += dp[i - 1][j]
                dp[i][j] %= MOD
    
    def count_ways_to_insert(s, n):
        m = len(s)
        dp = [[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(m + 1)]
        
        dp[0][0] = 1
        
        for i in range(1, m + 1):
            for j in range(i + 1):
                if j > 0:
                    dp[i][j] += dp[i - 1][j - 1]
                    dp[i][j] %= MOD
                if j < i:
                    dp[i][j] += dp[i - 1][j]
                    dp[i][j] %= MOD
        
        return dp[m][0]
    
    total_ways = 0
    for i in range(n - m + 1):
        prefix = s[:i]
        suffix = s[i:]
        left_ways = count_ways_to_insert(prefix, i)
        right_ways = count_ways_to_insert(suffix, n - i)
        total_ways += left_ways * right_ways
        total_ways %= MOD
    
    return total_ways
